name: 🪂 Ragdoll Physics [Skydiving]
desc:
Press 'F' to toggle ragdoll on and off
Press 'R' to toggle anti-gravity
Press 'T' to activate first person

New update:
- Skydiving
- New UI update
- Better control while floating

🥽 VR CONTROLS: PINCH to GRAB people / objects! 🤏

Ragdoll physics is a game with a unique ragdoll engine running it. Enjoy slow motion, spatial voice, voice chat, a unique map, and more. We've recently added VR support!
